explication: Reachy Mini is an expressive robot platform with Python and JavaScript SDKs, a local daemon, WebRTC media, simulation, and a Hugging Face app ecosystem. The principal workflow is: a user or app issues motion/media commands through the SDK, transport reaches the daemon, daemon routers dispatch them to robot control and media subsystems, and results return as robot state, movement, audio, or video. The tree supports the major branches below; several daemon wiring details are inferred only where endpoint/module names make them explicit.
